عَرًى A hard and elevated, or an elevated and plain, part, or tract, of the earth, that is apparent, or open: pl. أَعْرَآءٌ. (TA.) [عَرَآءٌ, also, (q. v.,) has a similar meaning, and the same pl.] ―
-b2- And i. q. حَائِطٌ [A wall; or a wall of enclosure; or one that surrounds a garden: or a garden, in general; or a garden of palm-trees, surrounded by a wall]. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also عَرًا in art. عرو: and in the same paragraph see its syn. عَرَاةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
